The refusal behaviour itself is correct and stays untouched.

- **Anchors verified on `origin/main` @ `34c01a5`**: stale present-tense "silently stripped at parse time" at `packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts:243`; the actual refusal message keyed on `permissions` at `:284`. Both as the card describes.
- **Grade**: queue-class — concrete, scoped, verified-current; natural member for the spec-surface seat's next sweep card (one line in a truth-sweep clean-up, `changeset` patch).
- **Dup check**: no open card owns this NOTE paragraph; the refusal-list work that introduced the drift is closed history.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

## Details

**Before -> after (packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts, ~line 239-244):**

Before:
> NOTE — there is deliberately NO per-skill `permissions` field. Access to AI capability is gated at the AGENT level (`agent.access` / `agent.permissions`, both enforced at the chat route), and each tool enforces its own authz when invoked. A `permissions` key authored on a skill is unknown to this schema and silently stripped at parse time — it grants and restricts nothing (ADR-0049: no unenforced security-shaped fields). Do not author one.

After:
> NOTE — there is deliberately NO per-skill `permissions` field. Access to AI capability is gated at the AGENT level (`agent.access` / `agent.permissions`, both enforced at the chat route), and each tool enforces its own authz when invoked. A `permissions` key authored on a skill is unknown to this schema and is REJECTED outright at parse time, with a located message keyed on `permissions` (see `guidance.permissions` below) pointing the author at the agent-level gate instead (ADR-0049: no unenforced security-shaped fields). Do not author one.

The refusal message at ~line 284 (`guidance.permissions`) was **not** touched — its "this was stripped in silence" phrasing narrates history and is correct as written, per the card.

`git diff` confirms only comment lines changed (2 removed / 4 added, both inside the block comment) — no schema, key, or behaviour change.

**Docs-render measurement:** The `NOTE` paragraph lives in the JSDoc block directly above `export const SkillSchema`, which is *not* the first docblock in the file (that's `SkillTriggerConditionSchema`'s, per the `#7113` positioning comment at the top of the file) — and `build-docs.ts` only renders the first docblock as the page blurb, plus each property's `.describe()` string into the properties table. Confirmed empirically: `content/docs/references/ai/skill.mdx` contains no occurrence of "silently stripped" or the NOTE text either before or after the change, and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:docs` (after a fresh `gen:schema`, since `json-schema/` is gitignored) reports "231 generated files in sync with packages/spec" with zero diff. No `content/docs/**` files were touched or need to be.

**Changeset:** Added `.changeset/skill-permissions-docblock-truth.md` (patch, `@objectstack/spec`), following the #7444 / #7473 / #7565 precedent for describe/TSDoc-only spec docs fixes.

**Labels:** No `skip-changeset` label applied — this PR ships a changeset, so that label does not apply. Read PR #7610 back after opening; Auto Label bot had not yet applied any labels at read time.

**Out-of-scope findings:** none.

**Open questions:** none — the card's fix was fully mechanical and unambiguous.

PR left in **draft**; not flipped ready, auto-merge not armed, not waiting on CI (PM owns convergence per the current reporting contract).
